split_note: 'cross_scroll' is a labelled reporting convention, not held-out secrecy: the ground truth comes from a public villa dataset and cannot be hidden. This split exists to report transfer across scrolls, not to withhold labels from entrants.

ground_truth.origin: villa fiber-skeletons dataset, dl.ash2txt.org/datasets/fiber-skeletons/ — every papyrus fiber in the cube hand-traced in WEBKNOSSOS at 7.91 um
ground_truth.note: n_fibers is every fiber in the raw NML trace. n_fibers_scored (and floors.*.n_gt_fibers) is smaller: it excludes fibers with 0 or 1 in-bounds nodes, since a fiber needs at least two in-bounds nodes to contribute a measurable run. Annotators traced beyond the cube boundary, so this gap reaches 10% on the shipped cubes.

convention_check.claim: NML nodes are x,y,z in absolute scroll space; volumes index z,y,x; the cube origin is encoded in the filename as <scroll>_<z>_<y>_<x>_<size>
convention_check.verified_against: labelsTr/s1_08997_02997_02497_256.tif (Dataset004_sk-fibers-binary-20250728, the semantic label of the same release)
convention_check.note_on_the_two_rates: measured_node_landing_rate_on_semantic_label is against labelsTr, villa's shipped semantic mask, and is at or above 0.999 on every shipped cube — the exporter refuses to ship one below that; the value measured for this cube is recorded above. That artifact is NOT what scoring uses. The figure that matters for scoring is measured_node_landing_rate_on_scoring_mask, against the fiber_hz_vt reference mask: lower, because the mask is a thresholded model output rather than a hand label, but many times chance, which is what establishes that skeleton and mask share a coordinate frame. Recomputed from shipped data by tests/test_fiber_target.py rather than trusted from this file.

mask.note: Every entrant is scored against this identical mask, so scorecard differences come from the instance labelling rather than from a better or worse segmentation.
mask.generated: probability volume produced locally by running scrollprize/fiber_hz_vt over the cube, not downloaded from the villa dataset; thresholded at 0.5 to give the shipped mask

floors_external_source.tracer_strict_relink: vesuvius-autoresearch finding 80 labelling (reports/tracer_rescore.md, prereg f5f775c3 + Amendment 1 aa1c5712): bench_cli trace at its published defaults (relink on, tangent window 1, no skips, no seed NMS). Re-scored against the Dataset004 annotation in finding 82 (reports/scrollgt_current_annotations.md, prereg 6185a0a6), whose rows this reproduces exactly. Re-scored from the same labelling with scoring version 3 in ScrollGT 0.7.0; its version-2 row reproduces exactly as erl_covered and erl_merge_penalized_covered.
